dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: I'm still conducting inspections, so if you have something to say, quick and simple's best.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: I'm an officer of general affairs here at Bayda Harbor. Call me Shajar, or Boss. Either's fine.

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: I'm not the sort to insist on honorifics. People should win respect through their actions.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Bayda Harbor...

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: Bayda Harbor's a place where many influential forces criss-cross, but the peace has been kept so far — it's my job to make sure everyone stays in their corner, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: So don't worry. Ordinary smugglers know better than to try anything cute here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually, it's nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: Well, no news is good news. See you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: It's just my job. Some people don't trust my origins, and if there's one thing I hate above all, it's doubters.

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, I almost forgot. I used to be an Eremite Mercenary... and then I accepted the Akademiya's employment offer. So now I run things here.

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: No difference between those jobs, if you ask me. "Get paid," "do stuff," and tack on a little "don't mess with me." Easy game.

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: Judging by your looks, you're that sort of person yourself, I'll wager?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about big-time smugglers?

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: If you mean the local Eremites, I was one of 'em once. I know how they do things.

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: As for those smugglers from Liyue and Fontaine...

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: Hmph. I'd be tipped off well before they could move a muscle, and I'd know their movements like the back of my hand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: Alright, that's enough chit-chat. I've got duties to get back to.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Secret letter?

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: Well, we've got too many outlanders here in Bayda Harbor, so some... diplomatic measures are necessary.

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: I've got "friends" in Lumidouce Harbor and Yilong Wharf, so we exchange tips and such. Good deal as far as I'm concerned.

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'd originally come here to relax a bit. Didn't think this place would be as busy as Port Ormos...
